causal_mechanism: Later finished-package reallocation could retain unused regions. Pre-bonding component allocation could instead preserve an ordinary 24 GB build.
history_support: A later inventory-adjustment motive is documented at platform level. No A30-specific package transfer or memory-part substitution is documented.
ordinary_explanation: Three 8 GB-class active stacks fit 24 GB and the specified active width. Product segmentation and faulty or absent inactive regions remain sufficient alternatives.
cohort_prediction: If later substitution or reassignment occurred, compare traceable later allocation/configuration groups with earlier A30 groups; a completed-package reassignment can preserve the original package and BOM revision.
temporal_exclusion: A 2022 demand event cannot cause the original 2021 configuration. Inventory on hand is not synonymous with completed HBM packages.
next_documentary_discriminator: Find dated A30 package/BOM changes or allocation/configuration records for the same package number; compare active and inactive population with earlier attributable groups.

history_support: AMD described adding 32 GB MI50 for customers seeking MI50 pricing and higher memory capacity. The 2019 supplier account also describes deployed 4 GB-class HBM2.
ordinary_explanation: Distinct 16/32 GB populations meet distinct customer needs. Four 4 GB-class stacks explain the lower-capacity product without unused ordinary memory.
cohort_prediction: If substitution occurred, original 16 GB OEM package/BOM groups should reveal a dated shift to denser parts while 16 GB exposure remains fixed.
temporal_exclusion: A shared 2018 date in current specification pages does not establish simultaneous introduction. A 2019 statement cannot retrospectively identify launch-era 16 GB parts.
next_documentary_discriminator: Find original 16 GB OEM BOM revisions, HBM part labels and qualification or allocation records; compare with the separate commercial 32 GB build.
